story_text:
Vikram a 23 yeold agriculture student, was returning to his village from his family fields when a sudden, severe windstorm struck the area. Realizing the intensity of the gale, Vikram immediately thought of the freshly harvested wheat stored under temporary tarpaulin sheds at the village Community Centre, which were highly vulnerable to such winds.
